lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਜਨ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jih jan ot gahee prabh teree se sukheee prabh sarane ||
lines.translation: Those who hold tightly to Your Support, God, are happy in Your Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਨਰ ਬਿਸਰਿਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਤੇ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਮਹਿ ਗਨਣੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jih nar bisariaa purakh bidhaataa te dukheeaa mahi ganane ||2||
lines.translation: But those humble beings who forget the Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny, are counted among the most miserable beings. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਗੁਰ ਮਾਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਤਿਹ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਰਸੁ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jih gur maan prabhoo liv laaee tih mahaa ana(n)d ras kariaa ||
lines.translation: One who has faith in the Guru, and who is lovingly attached to God, enjoys the delights of supreme ecstasy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੇਮੁਖਾਈ ਤੇ ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jih prabhoo bisaar gur te bemukhaaee te narak ghor mahi pariaa ||3||
lines.translation: One who forgets God and forsakes the Guru, falls into the most horrible hell. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit ko laaiaa tit hee laagaa taiso hee varataaraa ||
lines.translation: As the Lord engages someone, so he is engaged, and so does he perform.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹ ਪਕਰੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਰਿਦੈ ਭਏ ਮਗਨ ਚਰਨਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sah pakaree sa(n)tan kee ridai bhae magan charanaaraa ||4||4||15||
lines.translation: Nanak has taken to the Shelter of the Saints; his heart is absorbed in the Lord's feet. ||4||4||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ ਮਾਨਨ ਮਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raajan mahi raajaa urajhaaio maanan mahi abhimaanee ||
lines.translation: As the king is entangled in kingly affairs, and the egotist in his own egotism,

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਭਨ ਮਹਿ ਲੋਭੀ ਲੋਭਾਇਓ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਚੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: lobhan mahi lobhee lobhaaio tiu har ra(n)g rache giaanee ||1||
lines.translation: and the greedy man is enticed by greed, so is the spiritually enlightened being absorbed in the Love of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਇਹੀ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jan kau ihee suhaavai ||
lines.translation: This is what befits the Lord's servant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pekh nikat kar sevaa satigur har keeratan hee tripataavai || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Beholding the Lord near at hand, he serves the True Guru, and he is satisfied through the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਮਲਨ ਸਿਉ ਅਮਲੀ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ ਭੂਮਨ ਭੂਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: amalan siu amalee lapataaio bhooman bhoom piaaree ||
lines.translation: The addict is addicted to his drug, and the landlord is in love with his land.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੀਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਹੈ ਲੀਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਤ ਐਸੇ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kheer sa(n)g baarik hai leenaa prabh sa(n)t aise hitakaaree ||2||
lines.translation: As the baby is attached to his milk, so the Saint is in love with God. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਦਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਦੁਅੰਸੀ ਰਚਿਆ ਨੈਨ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bidiaa mahi bidua(n)see rachiaa nain dekh sukh paavahi ||
lines.translation: The scholar is absorbed in scholarship, and the eyes are happy to see.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਾਦਿ ਲੁਭਾਨੀ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jaise rasanaa saad lubhaanee tiu har jan har gun gaavahi ||3||
lines.translation: As the tongue savors the tastes, so does the humble servant of the Lord sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਭੂਖ ਤੈਸੀ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਕੁ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaisee bhookh taisee kaa poorak sagal ghataa kaa suaamee ||
lines.translation: As is the hunger, so is the fulfiller; He is the Lord and Master of all hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਆਸ ਲਗੀ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak piaas lagee darasan kee prabh miliaa a(n)tarajaamee ||4||5||16||
lines.translation: Nanak thirsts for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan; he has met God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||4||5||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮੈਲੇ ਤੁਮ ਊਜਲ ਕਰਤੇ ਹਮ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham maile tum oojal karate ham niragun too daataa ||
lines.translation: We are filthy, and You are immaculate, O Creator Lord; we are worthless, and You are the Great Giver.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਤੁਮ ਚਤੁਰ ਸਿਆਣੇ ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਕਾ ਗਿਆਤਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ham moorakh tum chatur siaane too sarab kalaa kaa giaataa ||1||
lines.translation: We are fools, and You are wise and all-knowing. You are the knower of all things. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਧੋ ਹਮ ਐਸੇ ਤੂ ਐਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: maadho ham aise too aisaa ||
lines.translation: O Lord, this is what we are, and this is what You are.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਤੁਮ ਪਾਪ ਖੰਡਨ ਨੀਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਦੇਸਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham paapee tum paap kha(n)dan neeko thaakur desaa || rahaau ||
lines.translation: We are sinners, and You are the Destroyer of sins. Your abode is so beautiful, O Lord and Master. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੇ ਸਾਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tum sabh saaje saaj nivaaje jeeu pi(n)d de praanaa ||
lines.translation: You fashion all, and having fashioned them, You bless them. You bestow upon them soul, body and the breath of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ ਗੁਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਤੁਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: niraguneeaare gun nahee koee tum daan dehu miharavaanaa ||2||
lines.translation: We are worthless - we have no virtue at all; please, bless us with Your gift, O Merciful Lordand Master. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਭਲਾ ਹਮ ਭਲੋ ਨ ਜਾਨਹ ਤੁਮ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tum karahu bhalaa ham bhalo na jaanah tum sadaa sadaa daiaalaa ||
lines.translation: You do good for us, but we do not see it as good; You are kind and compassionate, forever and ever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਬਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tum sukhadaaee purakh bidhaate tum raakhahu apune baalaa ||3||
lines.translation: You are the Giver of peace, the Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny; please, save us, Your children! ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅਟਲ ਸੁਲਿਤਾਨ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਜਾਚੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tum nidhaan atal sulitaan jee ja(n)t sabh jaachai ||
lines.translation: You are the treasure, eternal Lord King; all beings and creatures beg of You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਇਹੈ ਹਵਾਲਾ ਰਾਖੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak ham ihai havaalaa raakh sa(n)tan kai paachhai ||4||6||17||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, such is our condition; please, Lord, keep us on the Path of the Saints. ||4||6||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ghar 2 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਨ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਦੇ ਤਹ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maat garabh mahi aapan simaran de tah tum raakhanahaare ||
lines.translation: In our mother's womb, You blessed us with Your meditative remembrance, and You preserved us there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਕ ਸਾਗਰ ਅਥਾਹ ਲਹਰਿ ਮਹਿ ਤਾਰਹੁ ਤਾਰਨਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: paavak saagar athaah lahar mahi taarahu taaranahaare ||1||
lines.translation: Through the countless waves of the ocean of fire, please, carry us across and save us, O Savior Lord! ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਧੌ ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: maadhau too thaakur sir moraa ||
lines.translation: O Lord, You are the Master above my head.

lines.gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਧੋਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: eehaa oohaa tuhaaro dhoraa || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Here and hereafter, You alone are my Support. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਤੇ ਕਉ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਮਾਨੈ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: keete kau merai sa(n)maanai karanahaar trin jaanai ||
lines.translation: He looks upon the creation like a mountain of gold, and sees the Creator as a blade of grass.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਾਗਨ ਕਉ ਸਗਲੀ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: too daataa maagan kau sagalee daan dehi prabh bhaanai ||2||
lines.translation: You are the Great Giver, and we are all mere beggars; O God, You give gifts according to Your Will. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਖਿਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਅਵਰਾ ਅਚਰਜ ਚਲਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khin mahi avar khinai mahi avaraa acharaj chalat tumaare ||
lines.translation: In an instant, You are one thing, and in another instant, You are another. Wondrous are Your ways!

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੂੜੋ ਗੂੜੋ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੋ ਊਚੌ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: rooRo gooRo gahir ga(n)bheero oochau agam apaare ||3||
lines.translation: You are beautiful, mysterious, profound, unfathomable, lofty, inaccessible and infinite. ||3||
